subject: GCP private offer — stair-step multi-year prepay structure negotiation
messages:
From: Dana Chen <dana.chen@cloudwave.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer — multi-year prepay proposal & ramp schedule

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. CloudWave is evaluating a GCP Marketplace private offer for our inference footprint — we expect to use Redwood in a steady ramp across three years and want to lock in predictable unit economics. A few high-level asks to start the conversation: 

- Do you support a stair-step (year-by-year) committed prepay with tiered discounts for each year?
- How do you handle true-ups: annual, quarterly, or rolling? What is the billing timing?
- Can Redwood provide an example ramp schedule-based pricing band (year1–40%, year2–70%, year3–100% of target capacity) and corresponding discount schedule?

Procurement will need a clear amortization schedule and PO-friendly invoicing cadence to evaluate. I can loop in our Marketplace contact if you need platform specifics.

Attached is a one-pager of our expected usage profile (CloudWave_HW_inference_profile.pdf). Happy to hop on a call early next week.

Best,
Dana Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudWave

Attachment: CloudWave_HW_inference_profile.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Chen <dana.chen@cloudwave.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — multi-year prepay proposal & ramp schedule

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear asks and the profile. We absolutely support multi-year prepay on GCP Marketplace private offers and can structure stair-step prepay tiers with annual true-ups.

To be efficient, two quick clarifying questions before we draft a term sheet:
1) Is CloudWave planning to remit a single upfront payment per year, or prefer an upfront for all committed years?
2) Will you require the standard Marketplace uplift/fee offset itemized on the offer, or should we net that into the list price?

I'm attaching a draft term sheet to capture the high-level structure so we can iterate — initial placeholders for discounts and ramp are intentionally conservative. Aditya will follow up with a pricing band exercise once we confirm the ramp percentages. Vivek is copied for invoicing/PO cadence clarifications.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Mon/Tue to walk the term sheet and finalize true-up windows. Which timezone works best for you?

Thanks,
Evelyn
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Evelyn_Redwood_GCP_term_sheet_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

Cc: Dana Chen <dana.chen@cloudwave.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — multi-year prepay proposal & ramp schedule

Thanks Evelyn / Dana — looping in a first-pass pricing band model (attached). Notes: 

- We modeled three commitment vintages with list-price offsets for GCP Marketplace fees. The attached spreadsheet has scenarios for annual vs. upfront multi-year billing.
- Stair-step idea: year1 = 40% of committed capacity at 20% discount, year2 = 70% at 28% discount, year3 = 100% at 35% discount (example). We can make the bands denser (quarterly true-ups) but that increases accounting complexity on Marketplace.
- True-up recommendation: annual measurement with a 90-day reconciliation window post-year-end (redwood issues invoice/credit as applicable). This aligns with most marketplace billing flows.

Questions for CloudWave procurement to confirm:
- Do you require amortized monthly invoices for internal budget owners, or is a single annual invoice acceptable?
- Any vendor-specific PO/legal terms we should expect on the GCP offer (e.g., auto-renew opt-outs, early-termination language)?

Attaching the pricing workbook. If these rough bands look directionally correct, we can bake them into the term sheet and generate a v2 tailored to CloudWave usage.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-band-model.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — multi-year prepay proposal & ramp schedule

Evelyn / Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the model. A few clarifications from procurement and infra: 

- Ramp profile: we expect approx 40% of committed utilization in year 1, 70% in year 2, and 100% in year 3 (these are % of target committed capacity you modeled).
- Payment preference: CloudWave prefers annual upfront payments (one invoice per committed year), but we can consider a full multi-year upfront if you offer an additional incentive on top of the stair-step discounts.
- True-up window: annual true-up is acceptable. Procurement requests a 60–120 day reconciliation window; 90 days is ideal for our internal finance cycles.
- Marketplace fee handling: we prefer the offer to display the marketplace fee line-item (for our internal chargeback) rather than netting it. Is that feasible for Redwood in the GCP private offer?

Procurement will circulate standard PO templates once Redwood confirms the basic structure. Can you provide a sample amortization table and the exact invoice cadence you recommend for the annual upfront option? Also: any constraints around DocuSign/PO acceptance via the GCP offer flow?

Happy to take a 30-minute sync Tue morning.

Best,
Dana

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Chen <dana.chen@cloudwave.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — multi-year prepay proposal & ramp schedule

Hi Dana — thanks for the details, and great to align on the ramp. Below is our proposed structure reflecting your preferences and minimizing Marketplace complexity: 

Summary (proposal v2):
- Term: 3 years (36 months) with annual prepaid invoices (one invoice per committed year).
- Ramp & discounts: Year 1 target 40% (20% discount), Year 2 target 70% (28% discount), Year 3 target 100% (35% discount). Discounts apply to committed consumption bands; over-usage billed at on-demand list price and credited on next true-up.
- Upfront options: annual upfront by default; if CloudWave elects a single upfront payment for all 3 years, Redwood will add a 2.5% additional discount on the total committed value (subject to fiscal approvals).
- True-ups: annual measurement with a 90-day reconciliation window (invoices/credits issued 90 days after year-end).
- Marketplace fee: itemized line in the GCP private offer (we will surface the Marketplace uplift separately to satisfy your chargeback).
- Invoicing: Redwood issues one invoice per committed year; we can provide an amortization schedule for internal chargeback (monthly by cost center) on request.
- Legal/Docs: we can accept a CloudWave PO via DocuSign linked to the GCP private offer. GCP Marketplace requires certain offer fields; our legal ops will work with your procurement to confirm acceptance.

Next steps: Evelyn / Aditya to produce an amortization table and a populated term sheet (v2) reflecting the discount bands and the 2.5% multi-year upfront incentive. Vivek will draft the invoicing language for the PO. Dana — if this aligns, please share your procurement PO template and I will route to our legal ops to coordinate DocuSign.

I'll attach the revised offer doc for your review. If helpful, we can take the call Tue 10am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-gcp-private-offer-v2.pdf (pdf stub)
